organization: Corporate and Business Registration Department (CBRD), Ministry of Finance; operated via Mauritius Network Services (MNS)
notes: Authoritative Mauritius company/business register (CBRIS). The public search SPA (onlinesearch.mns.global, Angular) loads Cloudflare Turnstile (challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile) — search is CAPTCHA-gated, and document/file purchase is paid. No open bulk or free API (guessed API endpoints 404). Key = BRN (Business Registration Number). Directors/shareholders are personal data. Field model from public knowledge; nothing captured.

source_name: data.govmu.org — List of ICT Companies in Mauritius (Open Data)
organization: Mauritius (publisher: MDPA), via the national open-data portal (CKAN)
notes: Open CSV on the national CKAN portal (data.govmu.org). Verified live: 1,060 rows, CC-BY-SA-4.0. SECTORAL directory of ICT companies only: Title (company name), Address, District, Sectors, Other Related Sectors. NO identifiers (no BRN), no status, no incorporation date. Genuinely open but partial coverage (ICT sector). No personal data. A second related dataset 'List of ICT Companies with GPS locations' also exists.

source_name: Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM) — listed companies
notes: Stock Exchange of Mauritius. Browser-public listing/issuer pages: Official Market and DEM (Development & Enterprise Market) segments, with published accounts and company announcements per issuer. No clean single listed-companies list or JSON API found; navigable HTML across /listing-issuer-services/. Listed companies only.

National CKAN portal. The package_search API works. A q=company search returns only 3 datasets (two ICT-company directories + road accidents); a business/registration/CBRD search returns 0. No full company register is published here — only the sectoral ICT directory above. (Note: opendata.govmu.org and catalogue.data.govmu.org do not resolve; the working host is data.govmu.org.)
